definition.simple: How far your account has fallen from its highest point.
definition.balanced: Drawdown = (peak − current) ÷ peak. After a drawdown d, you need a gain of d ÷ (1 − d) to get back to the peak. A 20% drawdown needs a 25% gain. A 50% drawdown needs 100%.

example: Peak 10,000 USD, now 8,000 USD: drawdown is 2,000 ÷ 10,000 = 20%.
